answer: Under Regulation 1025/2012, European Standards Organisations (ESOs) are required to give SMEs access to standardisation activities for free or at special rates. The Oxford Commission's Harmonising AI paper recommends that education and training, specifically for non-expert AI stakeholders, must be available to facilitate understanding of and participation in ESOs. This training should be tailored to a wide variety of stakeholder groups to develop the capacity and skills needed to participate effectively in standards organisations.
